question: T12 (task-49c7ca40040f661a), after CAP-T12WAVEDRAG D: a desktop Wave Intensity drag that grows, falls and grows again: where does the Text block below end? On Blocks Probe at a 1600 by 1000 window, one new section per plan with a new Scrolling block and a Text block added after it, made on the desktop (desktop 1/2/3/26 and 1/2/3/10, phone 1/2/3/10 and 3/2/5/10); u first moves the Text block three rows down by arrow keys (4/2/6/10, 'arr'). Then the Scrolling block selected, Edit, Design ('open'), a press on Wave Intensity at 90, then a real drag through one DevTools session: a press on the range at 90, a move to each next value 300 ms apart (inputs about 400 ms apart), let go 300 ms after the last; a read, Escape (let go, 'go') and a read, then two Cmd+Z with a read after each. s and u: 90>120>150>180>150>120>90>120>150>180; t: the same, ending on 150. R1 ran s t u, R2 u t s, two edit sessions. Nothing saved: every session left by Exit Without Saving.
readsAre: As CAP-T12BELOW: layout of the Scrolling block and every block in its section, the section rows in the view shown, the Scrolling block's height and line, Undo and Redo, the panel's ranges; 'wave' is the panel's Wave Intensity value; 'inputs' the page's own record of pointerdown, input, change and pointerup on the range. The read's name is the run, the plan, and the steps in order, '>' between them ('z' is Cmd+Z).
answer: Only the end of each drag is read (after the let go); the states in between are not. s: 90 leaves the Scrolling block 1/2/5/26 and the Text block 3/2/5/10 (on the foot); the drag out to 180, back to 90 and out to 180 again ends 1/2/7/26 with the Text block at 7/2/9/10, the section 14 rows. CAP-T12WAVEDRAG D read the first half: out to 180 and back to 90 leaves it at 5/2/7/10, on the foot again; so the second growth (foot 5 to 7) took it down by 2.
t, the same out again only to 150 (foot 6): it ends 1/2/6/26 with the Text block at 6/2/8/10, the section 13 rows (from D's 5/2/7/10, down by 1).

u, the Text block a row under the foot (90: 6/2/8/10): the same drag ends 1/2/7/26 with the Text block at 8/2/10/10, the section 12 rows. A block moved down by every growth would end at 10/2/12/10 and 14 rows. The rule that fits s, t, u and D: a desktop drag's growth takes down, by the foot's change, only a block the new foot reaches, its top on or above the new foot's row (u's Text block is taken to 8/2/10/10 by the first growth, left there by the way back, and the second growth's foot, 7, does not reach it; to end at 8 the first growth must take it from 6 at the 150 step, whose foot is 6, on its row); as the foot falls blocks stay (D). Inferred, not read: u's states between.

Each drag is one undo step (its inputs about 400 ms apart): Escape keeps the areas, Cmd+Z gives back the 90 press's state (1/2/5/26 with 3/2/5/10, or 6/2/8/10 in u), the next the section as built. A change fires at the let go.
R1 and R2 read alike in all 22 reads, apart from Undo and Redo at a plan's start (Redo stays on from the plan before).
Not read: the states during the drag; a press growth that does not reach a block below; a block the moved block then reaches; the phone view; values a second or more apart.

localGuesses.written: before the reads, ours on main: a desktop drag takes a block below down by every growth, so u ends 10/2/12/10 and 14 rows; s 7/2/9/10 and 14 rows
